chapter: Players and bands of old New Orleans
title: Missed meeting and his wife's illness
summary: Russell and Laurent talk about missing each other, and his wife's long illness and hospital stays.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I thought I'd get to see you, but we didn't know it. We had the wrong night.

I ain't called old trombone club. Bill Matthews, I ain't met Bill there. Bill Matthews, yeah. I met Bill Matthews. I hadn't seen Bill in about five years. I met Bill Matthews there. I haven't been around Tom Alvarez since the last day we was around there.
I haven't been around there. That's what I'm telling you, son. I can't get out sometime. My wife was so sick.
It was the cold winter too to get around. I had to be right there. I had to be right there.
Oh, she had that chair and them crutches, and then she got her leg. Now, seven weeks. Well, she's walking with the stick. She can get around a little bit better. But I couldn't go nowhere.
I didn't get around much this last winter. You see, I didn't even come around your place.
I was tired and I was running backwards and forth to the hospital like that. Day and night. Day and night. I sat in the hospital until one, two o'clock in the morning. I shouldn't know.
